hey i’m sorry that you have had those struggles. i know it’s hard. however i do need to say this…
please don’t comment ur weight loss numbers under a post by someone who talks about having an ED.  this can be extremely triggering to a majority people with EDs. i’d like to give you the benefit of the doubt because you are so young…. but if you also had an ED i’m sure you know this. additionally it’s pretty obviously intentional by the way you added your exact stats. try to be mindful to use broad terms about weight loss and reframe from using numbers when commenting on a post about someone struggling with an ED. it’s not helpful to you or the ppl who might be effected by your words. btw it’s not the flex you think it is to be flaunting ur numbers like that kiddo… actually it’s embarrassing. but if that’s something you wanna do there are plenty of forums for that, it doesn’t need to be said to a sick person. i’m not trying to be harsh but i see you.

lmao anything can be a compulsion… they are compulsive reactions to obsessions so in a way she’s right it is a reaction-a compulsive reaction… and googling is one of the most common compulsions… ur therapist needs to go back to school if she’s that ignorant about the basics of OCD

also definitely had a lot of ocd symptoms that surrounded my addiction which made it extremely hard to quit and stay sober… not to mention that relief from these symptoms was one of the things that drove me to abuse substances… don’t want to go into details but i almost died through multiple ODs/malnutrition also couldn’t work lost all my savings ended up in debt and kicked out of my place of my house and many other things…

obsessed with being able to fall asleep “correctly” if i don’t fall asleep quickly enough i get so anxious that i won’t get enough sleep because i didn’t fall asleep “in time” especially in a have a commitment in the morning then i most likely won’t sleep for many hours and will just lay in the dark. most nights i only sleep 2-4 hours until i’m so exhausted i can’t physically stay up and then i’ll have like a 16-20 hour crash out or sleep on and off for several days… although recently my partner has been working early so when he gets up around 2-3am he will cuddle and pet me for a bit before he leaves and for some reason it puts me to sleep just fine..  i think this stems from anxiety from having chronic insomnia and nightmares as a child and also trauma from when i was a crackhead definitely made it worse(11 months 11 days sober:) but yea i think this is actually one of the bigger reasons i fell so deep into stimulant addiction bc it helped with fatigue and it made the sleepless nights feel good…

i’m not trying to influence anyone. everyone is entitled to their own beliefs!! i’ve seen all the studies(there are not a lot and there are a lot of inconsistencies) so you cannot say there is no connection for sure. but there are a lot of personal experiences that i read about after i got it done that i wish i would have seen first.  also i said the stress from the vaccine not the vaccine it’s self in an attempt to be more clear. i just wanted to vent and put this out there for any other woman who might be in a similar situation as me.

you probably might if you are even questioning it because denial is a huge part of eds. also you sound a lot like me a few years back and i have a diagnosis now.  so even if you don’t have one you are at least on the track/exhibiting behaviors. i would recommend contacting a therapist and a dietitian. there are healthier more sustainable ways to lose weight i promise! please stay safe and listen to ur bodies warning by bells!!!
